legend: The bone biopsy is hypercellular (nearly 100%) and shows myeloid hyperplasia with increased eosinophils and scattered immature-appearing mononuclear cells (<<36623>>). There is increased bone marrow fibrosis (reticulin) (<<36624>>).

The bone biopsy is hypercellular (nearly 100%) and shows myeloid hyperplasia with increased eosinophils and scattered immature-appearing mononuclear cells (<<36623>>). There is increased bone marrow fibrosis (reticulin) (<<36624>>).

The bone marrow aspirate smears show increased eosinophils and scattered blasts (~5% on differential cell count); the blasts had a myeloid immunophenotype by flow cytometric analysis in this case. There is no overt erythroid, granulocytic, or eosinophilic dysplasia (Giemsa).

G-banded karyogram of a patient with a translocation between the short arm of chromosome 12 and the long arm of chromosome 13; in addition, the derivative chromosome 12 is involved in a translocation with the long arm of chromosome 9: 46,XY,der(9)t(9;13)(q22;q34),der(12)t(12;13)(p13.2;q12.3)t(9;13)(q22;q34),der(13)t(12;13)(p13.2;q12.3), leading to an ETV6::FLT3 fusion confirmed by RT-PCR.
